turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to change the name on my flight reservation. I want to update it from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia. Can you help me with that?

I can help you with updating the passenger name on your reservation. To proceed, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for the booking you want to update. Could you please provide those details? If you don’t know your reservation ID, let me know and I can help you locate it.
Sure, my user ID is anya_garcia_5901 and the reservation ID is 3RK2T9. Please change the name from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia.

To confirm, you want to update the passenger name from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia on reservation 3RK2T9. All other details will remain the same.

Please confirm that you would like me to proceed with this name change.
Yes, please go ahead and make that change. I want the name updated to Mei Garcia.
The name on your reservation has been updated from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia. If you need any further assistance or want to review any other details, please let me know!
Thank you for your help. That’s all I needed.
You’re welcome! If you need any further assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day and safe travels!
